name: Evaporating Antitoxin
body:
In either case, the vapor created by a smashed vial disperses completely in one round. Evaporating antitoxin can also be drunk; it functions exactly as normal antitoxin does in this case.

Cost: 150gp
To Create: Craft (Alchemy)—DC 30
